name: Secrets Manager Secret Extraction
description: An attacker with secretsmanager:GetSecretValue can retrieve the plaintext value of secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager. secretsmanager:ListSecrets enumerates available secrets. Attackers target database credentials, API keys, and other sensitive values. Required permissions are secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to retrieve a secret and secretsmanager:ListSecrets to discover secrets. Resource-based policies on secrets may further restrict access.
mitigations: Use resource-based policies to restrict secret access
Rotate secrets automatically on a schedule
